name: Aquatic Internship Program
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks, Aquatics
what_you_do: You help pool staff and learn how to keep swimmers safe. You get safety and rescue training and a mentor from the aquatics team.
who_can_apply: Ages 12 to 15, in grades 7 to 10. You need a 2.5 GPA or higher and must pass a Red Cross Level 4 swim test. You also need your own ride.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The 2026 program page said applications close May 8, or sooner if the program fills. Interviews began the week of May 15. The next year is not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Add an unofficial school transcript, two letters of recommendation and a resume. Add a short letter, about one page, under the heading "Tell Us About You". Interviews follow.
notes: The program page does not give start and end dates or pay. Ask the aquatics team. Email arpdaquatics@alamedaca.gov or call the city at 510-747-7400. It is held at Encinal Swim Center, 230 Central Ave. Residency is not stated on the program page.
